Name: Suresh Patel
Feedback/Suggestions: The escrow feature provides great peace of mind when dealing with new buyers. However, I think adding a notification system for when funds are released would be very helpful.

Name: Anish Kumar
Feedback/Suggestions: Stellar network integration makes transactions super fast and cheap. It would be awesome if we could see a historical price chart for different crop types directly on the dashboard.

Name: Khushi Singh
Feedback/Suggestions: The user interface is very clean and easy to navigate on mobile. A suggestion would be to allow farmers to upload multiple images of their produce instead of just one.

Name: Arti Desai
Feedback/Suggestions: I love that it supports testnet XLM right now, but having a clear tutorial on how to bridge to mainnet USDC eventually would really help non-crypto native users.

Name: Prakash
Feedback/Suggestions: Great concept for agricultural marketplaces. It would be beneficial to add a messaging system so buyers can negotiate bulk orders before the smart contract is initiated.

Name: Rahul Kumar
Feedback/Suggestions: The platform is solid, but I ran into some confusion when trying to cancel an order before the farmer accepted it. Clearer status indicators would improve the experience.

Name: Rekha Nair
Feedback/Suggestions: Really appreciate the transparent fee structure. Adding multi-language support (like Hindi and Marathi) would definitely help onboard more local farmers in my region.
